died.name: Woodrow Wilson
died.last_words: When the machinery is broken... I am ready.

died.name: Ronald Ryan
died.cause: to the hangman. Ryan was the last person to be executed in Australia prior to the abolition of the death penalty in 1985
died.last_words: God bless you, please make it quick.

died.name: Karla Faye Tucker
died.desc: American double murderer who converted to Christianity in prison
died.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
died.last_words: Yes sir, I would like to say to all of you-the Thornton Family and Jerry Dean's family that I am so sorry. I hope God will give you peace with this. Baby, I love you. Ron, give Peggy a hug for me. Everybody has been so good to me. I love all of you very much. I am going to be face to face with Jesus now. Warden Baggett, thank all of you so much. You have been so good to me. I love all of you very much. I will see you all when you get there. I will wait for you.

born.name: Antonio José de Sucre
born.desc: Venezuelan independence leader and President of Peru and Bolivia
born.cause: after being shot while riding in the jungle of Colombia. He was said to be an educated gentleman who had never cursed until that day

born.name: Frederick William Robertson

born.last_words: I cannot bear it; let me rest. I must die. Let God do his work.

born.name: Walter Bagehot
